subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], Thank you for booking your upcoming flight with us. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for Flight ABC123 from City A to City B on [Date]. Please find your e-ticket attached to this email. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team at any time. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
